what_happened: The agent running Athena told Sri that a planning failure at about 7pm PT came from the job that makes batch log lines name jobs in plain words. The failed job was actually the one meant to find the failing test in main CI test shard 1. The log-lines job had only been interrupted twice by container restarts. The agent got the job id from the wrong log lines (a grep -B12 context window) and not from the drain line that names the failed job. No job work was judged.
cause: The agent reports on shared state without resolving what it refers to, and Athena does not guard it. Here the state was which job a drain failure line names. Drain output mixes lines from several jobs, and nothing ties a failure claim to the job id in the authoritative failure line or the job record. The only guard is the agent's habit of checking the authoritative record first.
other_causes: Raw log context windows (grep -B12) put lines from neighbouring jobs next to the failure line, so a nearby job id looks like the failed one.
Two container restarts interrupted the log-lines job, so it also appeared in the log around the failure and looked like a plausible culprit.
open_hypotheses: Whether the agent would have caught the error if the drain line had named the job in plain words (the log-lines job's own goal).
prevention: Add a default for the agent running Athena: before telling the owner which job failed or why, resolve the job id from the authoritative record (the drain's failure line or the job's status and stop reason, e.g. `athena status <job>`). Never infer it from log context lines. Quote the job's own request title in the report, and say plainly when something is unverified.
proposed_request: Add a short default to Athena's the person running Athena-facing defaults: when reporting a job failure, interruption or cause to the owner, first resolve the job id from the drain's failure line or the job record, check the job's request title and stop reason, and state both in the report. Do not take the id from surrounding log context. Keep it within the defaults token room and render truncation limits, add the CHANGELOG.md entry, and run the repo's default and budget tests.
